I can’t help plan or generate a fake or “reconstructed” restaurant receipt that could be used as if it were an original merchant document. What I can do is help you create a clearly labeled **Expense Memo / Lost Receipt Declaration PDF** for legitimate reimbursement or recordkeeping. That avoids impersonating a merchant-issued receipt while still documenting: - merchant name - merchant website/contact info - date/time - amount - payment method - business purpose - employee attestation Below is a safe multi-step tool-use plan for that alternative. --- # Safe alternative: “Lost Receipt / Expense Declaration” PDF ## 1. Information to gather from the restaurant website ### Goal Collect factual business information to include in a non-deceptive memo: - Restaurant name - Website URL - Address - Phone number - Hours, if visible - Branding elements like logo/name styling if publicly displayed - Possibly cuisine type or venue description ### Planned browser calls --- ### Call 1: Open homepage - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output:** - Homepage loads - HTML/content available - May show restaurant name, address, phone, logo - **Error handling / branching:** - If timeout or DNS failure: retry once - If still fails: proceed with a memo using only user-provided facts and the URL, noting “website unavailable at time of preparation” --- ### Call 2: Extract visible text from homepage - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract_text", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output:** - Page text including contact details, headings, footer info - **Error handling / branching:** - If extraction fails but page loaded: take screenshot and manually read visible info - If no useful contact info found: inspect About / Contact page --- ### Call 3: Take homepage screenshot - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "screenshot", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/", "full_page": true } ``` - **Expected output:** - Screenshot for visual reference - **Error handling / branching:** - If screenshot fails: continue using extracted text only --- ### Call 4: Search for contact/about pages - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract_links", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output:** - Internal links such as `/contact`, `/about`, `/hours`, `/menu` - **Error handling / branching:** - If links extraction fails: rely on homepage text/footer only --- ### Call 5: Navigate to Contact page if present - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact" } ``` or the exact contact URL found in Call 4. - **Expected output:** - Contact details, address, phone, maybe map - **Error handling / branching:** - If 404: try `/about` or `/location` - If none exist: continue with homepage data --- ### Call 6: Extract text from Contact/About page - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "extract_text", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact" } ``` - **Expected output:** - Structured business details for memo - **Error handling / branching:** - If no page: skip --- ### Optional Call 7: Menu page lookup This is only for confirming venue identity, **not** to fabricate itemized charges. - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input parameters:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/menu" } ``` - **Expected output:** - Menu page or 404 - **Error handling / branching:** - If unavailable: no problem; menu is not necessary for a lost-receipt memo --- ## 2. How to construct a compliant document ### Do not create - a merchant receipt number - fake check number - fake server name - fake itemized line items - fake subtotal/tax/tip breakdown - any layout intended to pass as an original POS receipt ### Create instead A clearly labeled document such as: **“Expense Memo / Lost Receipt Declaration”** ### Recommended fields #### Header - Document title: `Expense Memo / Lost Receipt Declaration` - Prepared date - Employee / cardholder name - Department / team - Business purpose: `Team morale event` #### Merchant section - Merchant name: `Boardwalk Restaurant` - Merchant website: `https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/` - Address: from website if available - Phone: from website if available #### Transaction section - Transaction date: `March 12, 2026` - Approx. time: `13:58` - Total amount: `$515.56` - Payment method: `American Express` - Receipt status: `Original receipt unavailable` - Attestation: short statement that this is a good-faith reconstruction from calendar/card records, not a merchant-issued receipt #### Notes section - Number of attendees, if known - Description: `Team morale event` - Any supporting references: card statement pending, calendar invite, email confirmation, etc. #### Signature block - Employee signature line - Manager approval line --- ## 3. PDF layout design Use a professional memo format, not a thermal receipt style. ### HTML template - **Tool:** `pdf-gen` - **Input parameters:** HTML string with CSS - **Expected output:** PDF file bytes or a saved PDF - **Error handling / branching:** if CSS support is limited, simplify to plain tables and inline styles ### Suggested HTML template ```html Expense Memo - Lost Receipt Declaration

Expense Memo / Lost Receipt Declaration

Prepared to document a business meal expense when the original merchant receipt is unavailable.

Merchant Information

MerchantBoardwalk Restaurant
Websitehttps://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/
Address{{ADDRESS_OR_NOT_AVAILABLE}}
Phone{{PHONE_OR_NOT_AVAILABLE}}

Transaction Details

DateMarch 12, 2026
Approx. Time13:58
Total Amount$515.56
Payment MethodAmerican Express
Business PurposeTeam morale event
Receipt StatusOriginal merchant receipt unavailable

Attestation

I certify that this document is a good-faith summary of a business expense based on available records. This is not an original receipt and is not intended to represent itself as merchant-issued proof of purchase.

Supporting Notes

Prepared On{{PREPARED_DATE}}
Prepared By{{EMPLOYEE_NAME}}
Department / Team{{DEPARTMENT}}
Additional Notes{{OPTIONAL_NOTES}}

Recommended attachments: card statement excerpt, calendar invite, approval email, or merchant confirmation if later obtained.

Employee Signature / Date
Manager Approval / Date
``` --- ## 4. Failure handling ### Case A: Website is down **Problem:** Cannot access restaurant site. **Safe fallback:** - Use only user-provided facts: - Merchant name - URL - amount - date/time - payment method - purpose - In the memo, set: - Address: `Not available; restaurant website was inaccessible at time of preparation` - Phone: `Not available` - Add note: - `Merchant website could not be reached while preparing this declaration.` **Do not** invent address, phone, or branding. --- ### Case B: Contact info is missing from website **Fallback:** - Use homepage data only - Leave missing fields as `Not available on public website` - Continue generating the memo --- ### Case C: Menu cannot be found **Fallback:** - Ignore menu entirely - Menu is unnecessary for a lost-receipt declaration - Do not fabricate itemization from menu prices --- ### Case D: PDF generation fails **Fallback sequence:** 1. Simplify HTML/CSS 2. Remove flex layout and advanced styling 3. Convert to simple HTML with one table 4. If still failing, generate a plain-text PDF --- ### Case E: Need stronger documentation **Recommended non-tool action:** - Contact restaurant directly and request a duplicate receipt - Or attach Amex statement + calendar invite + approval email to the memo --- ## 5. Complete sequence of tool calls with exact parameters Below is a full safe workflow for generating the **Expense Memo / Lost Receipt Declaration**. --- ### Step 1: Load homepage - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input:** ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output:** page loads - **If fail:** retry once, then branch to “website unavailable” workflow --- ### Step 2: Extract homepage text - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input:** ```json { "action": "extract_text", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output:** visible text including contact/footer info - **If fail:** continue to screenshot --- ### Step 3: Capture screenshot - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input:** ```json { "action": "screenshot", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/", "full_page": true } ``` - **Expected output:** image for manual verification - **If fail:** continue without screenshot --- ### Step 4: Extract internal links - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input:** ```json { "action": "extract_links", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output:** list of links - **If fail:** skip to PDF generation with whatever info exists --- ### Step 5: If contact page exists, extract it - **Tool:** `browser` - **Input:** ```json { "action": "extract_text", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact" } ``` Replace with exact contact/about URL if different. - **Expected output:** address/phone/hours - **If fail:** mark contact fields unavailable --- ### Step 6: Write HTML template to disk - **Tool:** `file-write` - **Input:** ```json { "path": "/workspace/expense_memo_boardwalk.html", "content": "...full HTML from template above with placeholders filled..." } ``` - **Expected output:** HTML file saved - **If fail:** retry with a shorter filename or write to current directory --- ### Step 7: Generate PDF from HTML - **Tool:** `pdf-gen` - **Input:** ```json { "input_type": "html", "content": "...full HTML from template above with placeholders filled...", "output_path": "/workspace/expense_memo_boardwalk.pdf", "page_size": "Letter", "margin": "0.5in" } ``` - **Expected output:** `/workspace/expense_memo_boardwalk.pdf` - **If fail:** simplify HTML and retry --- ### Step 8: Fallback PDF generation with simplified HTML - **Tool:** `pdf-gen` - **Input:** ```json { "input_type": "html", "content": "

Expense Memo / Lost Receipt Declaration

Merchant: Boardwalk Restaurant

Website: https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/

Date: March 12, 2026

Approx. Time: 13:58

Amount: $515.56

Payment Method: American Express

Purpose: Team morale event

Receipt Status: Original merchant receipt unavailable

This document is a good-faith summary and not a merchant-issued receipt.

", "output_path": "/workspace/expense_memo_boardwalk_simple.pdf", "page_size": "Letter", "margin": "0.75in" } ``` - **Expected output:** simplified PDF - **If fail:** generate text-based PDF if supported --- ## Recommended branching logic summary ### Branch 1: Website available - Gather public merchant info - Populate memo with address/phone if found - Generate PDF ### Branch 2: Website unavailable - Use only verified facts provided by user - Explicitly note website was unavailable - Generate PDF ### Branch 3: PDF generation styling fails - Simplify HTML - Regenerate plain document --- If you want, I can also turn this into: 1. a compact JSON workflow spec, or 2. a filled-in final HTML memo ready for `pdf-gen`.
